title: Custom Tools: Bit Box, Bent Housing, Seam Section
notes: Custom builder adds a Bit Box (body OD with its bit screwed in), an adjustable or fixed Bent Housing (Pad OD, Length To Center, ADJ or FXD, and a 0.00-3.00 degree bend setting with alignment lines), and a Seam Section. Flags re-letter by position as you slide them past each other, OD stations carry arrows on both sides, touch flags are two-thirds the size, and Total Length and ID sit at the bottom.
